sections.label: Book 36
sections.name: Preliminary formulas of the Pravargya; prayers for peace

verses.sa: ऋचं वाचं प्र पद्ये मनो यजुः प्र पद्ये साम प्राणं प्र पद्ये चक्षुः श्रोत्रं प्र पद्ये। वागोजः सहौजो मयि प्राणापानौ॥
verses.tr: ṛcaṃ vācaṃ pra padye mano yajuḥ pra padye sāma prāṇaṃ pra padye cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ pra padye vāgojaḥ sahaujo mayi prāṇāpānau
verses.en: Refuge I take in Speech as Rich; refuge in Mind as Yajus-text; refuge in Breath as Sama-chaut; refuge in Hearing and in Sight. Speech-energy endowed with strength, inbreath and out-breath are in me.

verses.sa: यन्मे छिद्रं चक्षुषो हृदयस्य मनसो वातितृण्णं बृहस्पतिर्मे तद्दधातु। शं नो भवतु भुवनस्य यस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yanme chidraṃ cakṣuṣo hṛdayasya manaso vātitṛṇṇaṃ bṛhaspatirme taddadhātu śaṃ no bhavatu bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ
verses.en: Whatever deeply-sunk defect I have of eye, or mind, or heart, that may Brihaspati amend! Gracious to us be he, Protector of the world.

verses.sa: भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि। धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥
verses.tr: bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
verses.en: Earth! Ether! Heaven! May we attain that excellent, etc., as in III. …

verses.sa: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा। कया शचिष्ठया वृता॥
verses.tr: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā
verses.en: With what help will he come to us etc., as in XXV I,'

verses.sa: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः। दृढा चिदारुजे वसु॥
verses.tr: kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ dṛḍhā cidāruje vasu
verses.en: What genuine, etc., as in XXVII.

verses.sa: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम्। शतं भवास्यूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Do thou who art, etc., as in XXVII.

verses.sa: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन्। कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर॥
verses.tr: kayā tvaṃ na ūtyābhi pra mandase vṛṣan kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.en: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring Riches to those who worship thee?

verses.sa: इन्द्रो विश्वस्य राजति। शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: indro viśvasya rājati śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: Indra is king of all that is: may weal attend our bipeds and our quadrupeds.

verses.sa: शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा। शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ
verses.en: Gracious be Mitra unto us, and Varuna and Aryaman; Indra, Brihaspati be kind, and Vishnu of the mighty stride.

verses.sa: शं नो वातः पवतां शं नस्तपतु सूर्यः। शं नः कनिक्रदद्देवः पर्जन्यो अभि वर्षतु॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no vātaḥ pavatāṃ śaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ śaṃ naḥ kanikradaddevaḥ parjanyo abhi varṣatu
verses.en: Pleasantly blow the wind for us, may Sdrya warm us pleasantly. Pleasantly, with a roar, the God Parjanya send the rain on us.

verses.sa: अहानि शं भवन्तु नः शं रात्रीः प्रति धीयताम्। शं न इन्द्राग्नी भवतामवोभिः शं न इन्द्रावरुणा रातहव्या। शं न इन्द्रापूषणा वाजसातौ शमिन्द्रासोमा सुविताय शं योः॥
verses.tr: ahāni śaṃ bhavantu naḥ śaṃ rātrīḥ prati dhīyatām śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatāmavobhiḥ śaṃ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau śamindrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: May days pass pleasantly for us, may nights draw near delightfully. Befriend us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuna who taste oblations. Indra and Pushan be our help in battle, Indra and Soma give health, strength, and comfort,

verses.sa: शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये। शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ
verses.en: May the celestial Waters, our helpers, be sweet for us to drink. And flow; with health and strength to us.

verses.sa: स्योना पृथिवि नो भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी। यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथाः॥
verses.tr: syonā pṛthivi no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ
verses.en: Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, etc., as M in XXXV.

verses.sa: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन। महे रणाय चक्षसे॥
verses.tr: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana mahe raṇāya cakṣase
verses.en: Ye, Waters, are, etc., as in XL

verses.sa: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः। उशतीरिव मातरः॥
verses.tr: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ uśatīriva mātaraḥ
verses.en: Give us a portion, etc., as in XI.

verses.sa: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ। आपो जनयथा च नः॥
verses.tr: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha āpo janayathā ca naḥ
verses.en: To you we gladly come, etc., as in XI.

verses.sa: द्यौः शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिः पृथिवी शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिः। वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वे देवाः शान्तिर्ब्रह्म शान्तिः सर्वं शान्तिः शान्तिरेव शान्तिः सा मा शान्तिरेधि॥
verses.tr: dyauḥ śāntirantarikṣaṃ śāntiḥ pṛthivī śāntirāpaḥ śāntiroṣadhayaḥ śāntiḥ vanaspatayaḥ śāntirviśve devāḥ śāntirbrahma śāntiḥ sarvaṃ śāntiḥ śāntireva śāntiḥ sā mā śāntiredhi
verses.en: Sky alleviation, Air alleviation, £Earth alleviation, Plants alleviation, Trees alleviation, All-Gods alleviation, Brahma alleviation, Universe alleviation, just Alleviation alleviation—may that alleviation come to me!

verses.sa: दृते दृंह मा मित्रस्य मा चक्षुषा सर्वाणि भूतानि समीक्षन्ताम्। मित्रस्याहं चक्षुषा सर्वाणि भूतानि समीक्षे। मित्रस्य चक्षुषा समीक्षामहे॥
verses.tr: dṛte dṛṃha mā mitrasya mā cakṣuṣā sarvāṇi bhūtāni samīkṣantām mitrasyāhaṃ cakṣuṣā sarvāṇi bhūtāni samīkṣe mitrasya cakṣuṣā samīkṣāmahe
verses.en: Caldron, strengthen me. May all beings regard me with the eye of a friend. May! I 'regard all beings with the eye of a friend. With the eye of a friend do we regard one another.

verses.sa: दृते दृंह मा। ज्योक्ते सन्दृशि जीव्यासं ज्योक्ते सन्दृशि जीव्यासम्॥
verses.tr: dṛte dṛṃha mā jyokte sandṛśi jīvyāsaṃ jyokte sandṛśi jīvyāsam
verses.en: Do thou, O Caldron, strengthen me. Long may I live to fo look on thee. Long may I live to look on thee.

verses.sa: नमस्ते हरसे शोचिषे नमस्ते अस्त्वर्चिषे। अन्याँस्ते अस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: namaste harase śociṣe namaste astvarciṣe anyāṃste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava
verses.en: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow, etc, as in XXII.

verses.sa: नमस्ते अस्तु विद्युते नमस्ते स्तनयित्नवे। नमस्ते भगवन्नस्तु यतः स्वः समीहसे॥
verses.tr: namaste astu vidyute namaste stanayitnave namaste bhagavannastu yataḥ svaḥ samīhase
verses.en: Homage to thee the lightning flash, homage to thee the thunder's roar! Homage, O Bounteous Lord, to thee whereas thou fain wouldst win to heaven!

verses.sa: यतो-यतः समीहसे ततो नो अभयं कुरु। शं नः कुरु प्रजाभ्योऽभयं नः पशुभ्यः॥
verses.tr: yato-yataḥ samīhase tato no abhayaṃ kuru śaṃ naḥ kuru prajābhyo'bhayaṃ naḥ paśubhyaḥ
verses.en: From whatsoever trouble thou desirest, give us safety thence. Give to our children happiness and to our beasts security.

verses.sa: सुमित्रिया न आप ओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly, etc., as in

verses.sa: तच्चक्षुर्देवहितं पुरस्ताच्छुक्रमुच्चरत्। पश्येम शरदः शतं जीवेम शरदः शतं शृणुयाम शरदः शतं प्र ब्रवाम शरदः शतमदीनाः स्याम शरदः शतं भूयश्च शरदः शतात्॥
verses.tr: taccakṣurdevahitaṃ purastācchukramuccarat paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śataṃ śṛṇuyāma śaradaḥ śataṃ pra bravāma śaradaḥ śatamadīnāḥ syāma śaradaḥ śataṃ bhūyaśca śaradaḥ śatāt
verses.en: Through hundred autumns may we see that bright Eye.
